main_text.p: CAPILLI fidelium omnes à Deo seruantur, Matt.10.30. Luc.21.18. capilli Absalom & eorum pondus, 2.Sam.14.26. capilli ex capite non cadent, 1.Sam.14.45. 1.Reg.1.52. Act.27.34. Hebraicum est Proverbium, quo significatur aliquos saluos & incolumes fore (V. CADERE humi, Dan.3.27.
CAPPADOCIA, regio in capite Syriæ, id est, ad Septentrionem. Act.2.9. 1.Pet.1.1.
CAPRAE oblatio & visus Iudæis permissus, Leuit.3.12. Deut.14.4.
CAPTIVITAS: iis denuntiata qui mandata Dei infringunt, Deut.28.v.41.45.64.68. Captiuitas pro captiuis, Hebraismus, Eph.4.8.

CAPTIVI in Babylonia iubentur orare pro pace ciuitatis, Ier.29.7. Captiua mulier quomodo ducenda in uxorem, Deut.21.v.11.12.13. [Captiuitas, i. captiuorum multitudo, præsertim Iudæorum, Ps.126 1.4. Esa.45.13 & 49.25. Ier.29.14. Ezec.29.14.&39.25. Captiuitas, i. captiui hostes Ecclesiæ per Christum in triumphum ducti, Ps.68.19. Eph.4.8.] Captiuos inuisere bonum & pium est, Gen.14.14. 1.Sam.30.19. Ier.38 9. Matth.25.37. Act.12.5. 2.Tim.1.16. Heb.13 3. Captiuos non deserit Deus, Gen.39.21. Ps.105.v.17.18.19. Esa.42.7. Act.5.18 & 12.17. & 16.25.

Captiuorum hominum exempla: Loth, Gen.14.v.12.13.14. Madianitarum uxores & parvuli, Num.31.9. Israelitæ, Iudic.2.14. filia quædam, 2.Reg.5.2. Equites mille septingenti, & viginti millia militum, 2.Sam.8 4. Amasias, 2.Reg 14.13. Sacerdotes, 17.27. uxores Dauidis, filij & filiæ, 1.Sam.30.v.3 4 5. Beera, 1. Paral.5.6. Iesana, Ephron, 2. Paral.13.19. decem millia virorum, 2.Paral.25.v.11.12. Achas, 28.v.5. Iudæi eorumque mulieres & parvuli, v.8. Manasses, 33 11. Sedechias Ier.39 5. reliquiæ populi & filiæ Regis, in Maphat, Ier.41 10. Vide COMPREHENSORVM, &c. exempla.

Captiuarum ciuitatum & regionum exempla: Villæ seu viculi Lazer, Numer.21.32. Iericho, Ios.6.20. Ai, Ios.8.19. Maceda Ios.10.28. Gazer, v.33. 1.Reg.9.16. Lachis, Ios.10.33. Dabir v.38.39. Gosen, v.41. cariat Sepher, Ios.15.17. Leiem, 19.47 Ierusalem, Iudic.1.8. Ier.38 28. Gaza, Iudicum 1,18. Rumā 9.45. Sion, 2.Sam.5.7. Syria, 8.13. Rabbah, 12 29. Geth, 1 Reg.12.17. Aion, &c.15.29. Samaria, 18 v.10.11. Ciuitates Iuda, 18.13. Geffur & Aram, 2.Paral.2.23. Bethel, 13.19. ciuitates Ephraim, 17.2. Bethsames, Aialon, &c.28.18. Azotum Esai.20.1. Carioth, Ier.48.41.

page.notes: Margin notes on the right edge are cut by the gutter and too faint to read; not transcribed. Some Latin reference numbers and marginal text are uncertain. The catchword "CAPTIV" at lower right is treated as a catchword.
